reason: Conversation 1 explained 4C as a water supply error and asked for the supply valve and hose kinks first, which is the sensible first step. It confirmed that a slot at 90 degrees means closed, guided the user to open it, and wrapped up concisely once the fault cleared. Conversation 2 opened with a long, over-broad list that pushed disconnecting the hose and removing the inlet valve assembly without telling the user to isolate power first. It also quoted an unverified part number and said replacing the inlet valve was likely if cleaning failed, which are unsupported part claims for a simple closed-valve fault. Its closing summary was sound but repetitive, and it never mentioned the plumbing work as the likely cause.
